sample_unit: patients with ocular myasthenia gravis (phase 2); 23 patient questions and 130 exam questions in phase 1

links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses to OMG patient questions, rated by ophthalmologists and patients
links.effect: GEMINI easiest to understand; GPT-4o most complex, suitable for higher-education readers. Patients rated Ernie 3.5 slightly more readable than ChatGPT o1-preview (4.31 vs 4.03, P=.01).
links.quote: GEMINI (Google DeepMind) provided the easiest-to-understand responses in readability assessments, while GPT-4o had the most complex responses, suitable for readers with higher education levels.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates multiple LLMs for patient education in ocular myasthenia gravis using medical exam questions, simulated expert ratings, and interactive testing with 20 real patients, but it assesses baseline model capabilities rather than testing a specific implementation safeguard or deployment practice.
